gen_convs.content:
Great — I found two available options from Dollar for a pickup at Dallas–Fort Worth Intl (DFW) on 2024-11-20 at 07:00 with drop-off at George Bush Intercontinental (IAH) on 2024-11-29 at 13:00. Summary and details for each car type below, plus practical notes and recommendations.

Rental period
- Pickup: DFW, 2024-11-20 at 07:00
- Drop-off: IAH, 2024-11-29 at 13:00
- Length: about 9 days (quote system may count days slightly differently; prices are the quoted drive-away totals below).

Option A — Standard (Volkswagen Jetta)
- Vehicle: Volkswagen Jetta (listed as “Standard”)
- Seats: 5
- Luggage: listed as up to 4 small suitcases (trunk capacity suitable for 2–3 medium bags or 4 smaller bags)
- Doors / Transmission: Automatic
- Air conditioning & airbags: included
- Fuel policy: Like-for-like (return with same fuel level)
- Mileage: Unlimited
- Free cancellation: Yes (quote shows free cancellation)
- Supplier & rating: Dollar (customer rating ~6.7 / 10)
- Pickup location (DFW): Shuttle bus pickup — address in quote: 2424 East 38th Street, Dallas, TX 75261. You will likely need to take the rental shuttle from the airport terminal to the Dollar lot.
- Drop-off location (IAH): Shuttle/lot address in quote: 17330 Palmetto Pines, Houston, TX 77032. Follow Dollar drop-off signage or call supplier for instructions.
- Price and payment (from the quote):
  - Quote drive-away price: USD 512.59 (this is the total quoted price in the search result)
  - Displayed “deposit” / immediate payment field: USD 413 (the booking system shows a prepayment/deposit figure)
  - Known small fees shown in the breakdown: AP CONC FEE RECOV ≈ $8.33, state/city taxes ≈ $4.17 each (these are already included in the drive-away figure)
  - Pay when: PAY_NOW (booking flow indicates payment is collected at booking)
  - Note on card hold: the fee breakdown shows a deposit/hold range by the supplier (examples in the quote show up to ~$685). Exact refundable hold at pickup is set by the supplier and depends on their policy and extras/insurance selections.

Best if: you need more passenger space or trunk room for luggage and want more comfortable highway driving.

Option B — Economy (Chevrolet Spark)
- Vehicle: Chevrolet Spark (listed as “Economy”)
- Seats: 4
- Luggage: listed as up to 2 small suitcases (best for solo travelers or couples with light luggage)
- Doors / Transmission: Automatic
- Air conditioning & airbags: included
- Fuel policy: Like-for-like / Return same (quote shows RETURN_SAME in fee breakdown)
- Mileage: Unlimited
- Free cancellation: Yes
- Supplier & rating: Dollar (rating ~6.7 / 10)
- Pickup location (DFW): Same shuttle pickup address: 2424 East 38th Street, Dallas, TX 75261
- Drop-off location (IAH): Same drop-off address: 17330 PalMETTO PINES, Houston, TX 77032
- Price and payment (from the quote):
  - Quote drive-away price: USD 507.91 (total quoted price)
  - Displayed deposit / immediate payment: USD 408.32
  - Known small fees: AP CONC FEE RECOV ≈ $8.33, state/city taxes ≈ $4.17 each (included in drive-away price)
  - Pay when: PAY_NOW
  - Card hold: supplier may place a refundable hold (quote shows deposit ranges similar to above). Confirm at booking.

Best if: traveling solo or as a couple, mostly city driving, want the lowest price and best fuel economy; not recommended if you have lots of luggage or 4 adults with big bags.

Practical notes & booking tips
- One-way drop-off between airports (DFW → IAH) is supported in the quote and included in the price shown.
- Free cancellation is shown in both quotes, but cancellation window/conditions should be checked during booking.
- Payment: the quote indicates PAY_NOW. Bring the same card used for booking and a second card if required for the supplier’s hold.
- Card hold / security deposit: the supplier commonly places a refundable hold at pickup in addition to any prepaid amount. The quote shows a prepayment/deposit figure (around $408–$413) and a potential hold range up to ~ $685 in the fee breakdown — confirm exact amounts with Dollar before pickup.
- Driver requirements: valid driver’s license, often held for at least one year; credit card in driver’s name for the deposit; age restrictions or young driver surcharges may apply — check Dollar’s policy.
- Insurance and extras: basic cover options and add-ons (CDW/LDW, additional driver, child/booster seats, GPS) are typically offered at the desk and are not included in the quoted drive-away price. If you decline supplier insurance, ensure your credit card or personal auto policy provides sufficient coverage.
- Fuel: Return at the same level (like-for-like / return same). Confirm exact policy at pickup.
- Shuttle: allow extra time on arrival at DFW to catch the rental shuttle to the depot; plan 30–60 minutes after landing depending on terminal and shuttle schedule.
- Inspect vehicle carefully at pickup and report any existing damage.

Which to choose?
- Choose the Standard (Jetta) if you have 3–4 passengers or more luggage and want a more comfortable highway car for the DFW→IAH drive.
- Choose the Economy (Spark) if you want the lowest-priced, most fuel-efficient option and are traveling light (1–2 people with little luggage).

If you want, I can:
- attempt to reserve one of these options (I’d need your preference and any driver age/extra options), or
- fetch further details such as exact refundable-hold amount and available extras/prices from the supplier for the chosen vehicle.
